description: Send the user's own verdict on something EditAtlas gave you, after they have seen the result: did the technique, sound, template, style, skill or workflow work for their edit? Ask the user and send only what they said; never rate on their behalf, and send nothing if they did not answer. Stores the verdict, the item's id and an optional short note in the user's words; no footage, file names, studio links or personal details.

id.description: The id EditAtlas gave: a technique slug, a sound id, a template or style id, a skill name, a video_type for workflow, or the music, photo or video id

note.description: Optional: what the user said about it, in their words, without names, file names or other personal details

name: send_feedback
